fallbacks.notes: Default Claude-lane reviewer for plans and implementations, and the default at high stakes; succeeds opus-5 at about half the per-task cost. Coding facet rests on Terminal-Bench 4.0 alone (DeepSWE has no opus-5-5 row). Pass the model explicitly when spawning - subagents otherwise inherit the session model.
Superseded by opus-5.5 as the Claude-lane default (same tier, about half the per-task cost). Keep the route for explicit use and for callers pinned to it.
Session model in Claude Code; subagents inherit it unless a model is passed explicitly. Reserve it for the taste-9 gate, not for raw intelligence: opus-5.5 is the cheaper default at the same tier.

selection.notes: OpenAI's frontier model: top of this registry on DeepSWE (0.73), Omniscience (43.7) and AutomationBench (0.67) at its high cap, at about half opus-5's cost per task. Opus-5.5 leads it on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (0.57 against 0.54). Slowest to answer of the three GPT routes (47 s total response at high). Shares the Codex usage limit with gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-luna. Codex usage limit: a rate-limit failure advances to the next route; do not retry this route in the same turn. Measured on macOS: the Codex sandbox denies Mach port registration, so this route cannot launch a browser (browser-tools ledger E47); browser-dependent work must not route here.
